task.name: Long intervals containing no modular inverse pair
task.family: science prize b inverse free interval
task.description: Return [start,length] for a nonempty interval contained in [1,1008]. For EVERY x,y in the interval, including x=y, require x*y %1009 !=1. Maximize interval length. Finite obstruction search for the modular inverse-pair interval question. Diagonal pairs are checked, so the self-inverse residues 1 and 1008 cannot be present; this is stricter than the preliminary distinct-pair proposal.
